scientific_integrity: Analytical differentiation and pointwise binomial expansion prove the statement for all real sensitivities at least two; finite exact checks and numerical root brackets are supplementary and not infinite certificates. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Results concern the high/low environmental Markov chain after strategies are independently sampled once and frozen, not the adaptive coevolution of players or actual equilibrium frequencies in a network. The sign applies eventually at fixed interior cooperation probability away from the single crossover; critical-point higher terms and finite-group crossover uniqueness are not asserted.
title: A unique finite-hyperedge environment-bias threshold with logarithmic sensitivity scaling
